<reason>Side A won the live clash on cost structure: content is bought up front, so frictionless pause/remix is adverse selection, not a free click. Side B’s “idle seats cost nothing to serve” and “stay-put can just be a discount” never survived that distinction or the rare-vs-common pause dilemma, while A’s transit-pass comparison made cheap-and-fickle vs committed commissioning easier to vote on.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s idle-seat turn (serving a paused login is cheap; buying the league/drama is not) plus the follow-through that a refuseable sports line becomes unaffordable in-season or dead off-season.</best_rebuttal>
